description: Extends the org policy for Kotlin Multiplatform repos (3-day soak, kotlin-toolchain and first-party holds; see meshtastic/.github:kmp-library.json). Aether is an app built with the Kotlin Toolchain, not Gradle, so two versions live outside the catalog: Kotlin and Compose in common.module-template.yaml, read here by regex managers. The toolchain itself (kotlin_cli_version and its sha256 in the ./kotlin wrapper) is updated by `./kotlin update` in the nightly toolchain-update workflow, never by Renovate, because a regex cannot recompute the checksum. packageRules apply in order and the last match wins.

customManagers.description: Kotlin in the toolchain template, pinned to the meshtastic-sdk compiler so its klibs link.
Compose Multiplatform in the toolchain template, which versions every $compose.* library; it shares the compose-multiplatform group with the catalog's Compose entries.

packageRules.description: HOLD: Kotlin in the toolchain template moves with the preset's kotlin-toolchain group, which only matches the Gradle manager. It must stay on the meshtastic-sdk's compiler, so a human checks the SDK first.
